eligibility_rule: Exclude from the nine-action shared pool any protocol whose label appears among the six heldout forecast labels; this corrects overlap discovered after the z_rebound canary, where there was no overlap.
coverage_rule: Greedy minimize mean nearest standardized generic waveform-feature distance from public forecast protocols over eligible actions; deterministic index tie-break
random_rule: Uniform sample of four distinct eligible protocols without replacement using fixed generator seed
forecast_rule: Common public-only ridge regression on eight generic waveform features and acquired spike counts; fixed penalty 1.0, unpenalized intercept, nonnegative predictions
primary_metric: Official floored spike forecast MSE across all six forecast labels, computed after frozen predictions; report per designed world without inferential pooling
gate: Freeze public questions and both action plans in Git before submitting outcome jobs; require exact four-action cost, no action/forecast overlap, complete six-label predictions, source/receipt hashes, and scorer parity
interpretation: Weak public-only action and forecasting control; not a mechanistic hypothesis library or foundation-model result. z_rebound v1 remains a separately labeled development canary.
forbidden: No world-specific discriminator mapping, upstream truth tables, test target values, Azure, or any closed-source model API in policy or forecaster
